terra.problem: The passage does not say Rebekah and Jacob acted because they wanted to rush God’s promise or thought God needed their help. Those motives are presented as fact rather than interpretation.
Jacob had already left before Esau returned and cried, so he did not walk out with a brother who was crying. The passage also does not say Isaac was in a tent.
The lesson about waiting for the right time depends on an impatience motive the passage does not establish.
